description: One run in detail: status, error and warnings (each with its key for ignore_finding; ignored ones marked), each step, visual comparisons (each with its comparisonId, links to the screenshot, the baseline and the diff that work for 10 minutes, and whether a decision on it can be undone), metrics, the one-click fix the run proposes if any, and Relvato AI's suggestion once requested. Large metrics are compacted, never the findings: daily series become summaries and what was left out is listed in metricsTrimmed.
name: get_run
title: Get run details
